storyline_en: A bike racer meets a girl and slowly realises they were lovers 400 years ago, when he was a warrior who died protecting her.
Two babies are swapped at birth. The poor boy grows up and ends up working in the house of his real, rich family.
A young man is killed by a jealous rich man who wants his girl. He is reborn as a tiny housefly and takes revenge.
A brilliant but short-tempered surgeon falls apart when his college girlfriend is married off to someone else.

storyline_en: A boy raised in a village below a giant waterfall climbs it and discovers he is the true heir of a kingdom ruled by a cruel king.
A fearless young man works as a hired gunman for the Hyderabad mafia, but he is hiding a big secret about who he really is.
In a 1980s village, a cheerful man who is hard of hearing stands up to the powerful village president who has ruled for decades.
The life story of a legendary actress of South Indian cinema, from her childhood and huge stardom to her heartbreaking fall.
A talented cricketer who gave up the game returns at 36 to play again, so he can buy his little son a team shirt.
A young lecturer makes a terrible first impression on a girl during a bus journey, then finds out she is his sister's new family.
Two school sweethearts meet again at a class reunion more than 20 years later and spend one long night catching up.

storyline_en: A timid, rule-obsessed lawyer has a hidden second personality that punishes people for everyday corruption.
A kabaddi player on his way to a match rescues a girl from a powerful goon who wants to marry her by force.
A tough police officer's special squad takes on a ruthless gang, and the gang leader goes after the woman he loves.
A scientist builds a robot that looks exactly like him. The robot learns emotions and falls for the scientist's girlfriend.
After his young son kills a powerful landlord, a quiet farmer goes on the run with him, and his own violent past comes back.
A village boy who served in the air force fights big business to start an airline so ordinary people can afford to fly.
A simple village girl marries a city man. On a work trip to Kashmir he is kidnapped, and she fights to bring him home.
A young couple fall in love on Chennai's local trains, marry secretly against their families, and then learn how hard married life is.
An army officer home on leave in Mumbai stumbles on a network of sleeper cells and quietly hunts them down before an attack.
